text: Step 12 also covers: the tasks widget beside the chat (chat.js:256, bh-tasks-widget-list) scrolls on its own; wheel over it must not scroll the chat feed (the feed's on_scroll_wheel at chat.js:435 catches it today). From the person's comment.

Step 5 also covers: on the active task's own row (tasks widget beside the chat, chat.js ~256, and the Tasks page list), the mark does not blink; only the active step's mark blinks. The agent-to-work flow animation goes on the active step row, not the task name. From the person's comment with a screenshot.
design: palette muted edges for non-own themes (contrastOf exported from look.js); settings.js Instructions field writes roster key 'instructions' via change()

Step 13 also covers: attached images show as thumbnails on top of the composer box (today they sit inside the box, composer.js:955-972, and only when previews() succeeds, composer.js:494-500; otherwise a name chip). Find why a preview can fail (e.g. a pasted ScreenClip path under AppData) and fall back to showing the image file itself. From the person's comment.

Roster entry gains instructions: string (may be missing or ""). bh team save --data <roster> keeps it as given; roster() fills it with "" when missing. On load, args with no word starting with '-' move to instructions (appended after a blank line) and args becomes ""; looksLikeInstructions(args) and migrateArgs(a) are exported from roster.js.

Step 1: instructions field + brief section '## The person's instructions for you'; args migration saved by team(); bh spawn on win32 uses hc run -- argv (hc runs a template's command: through sh -c on Windows, any template, not the apostrophe). Verified: bh spawn research (agy) starts and replies.

gpui-base Checkbox/Tooltip components not found in codebase; implemented read-only visual checkbox marks and seat icons without hover tooltips. Plan composer embedded by overriding send to route to plan-comment path (may need refinement).

Steps 5-7: checkboxes are custom read-only marks (rounded square r4; accent+tick done, pulsing inner while active, amber ! blocked) — gpui-base ships no Checkbox primitive, so the plan's gpui-base Checkbox decision was infeasible. --from orchestrator

Carry-over polish for the steps 10-15 design wave: (a) Plans seat icons need the agent name on hover (hover-shown label; no tooltip primitive); (b) flow dots on active step rows should start at the working agent's icon (icon at row start, dots sliding icon->title). --from orchestrator

Review of steps 10-13: toast exits OK; chat scroll, verb crossfade, flow dots and the folded composer need a fix round (brief-design-fix.md), which also wires /bh-knowledge into the composer and the Jev/Laya/Clef choices into Settings. team.hc no longer uses a shell on Windows (BH_HC names a stand-in script for tests).

design-fix: A-G done (pixel chat scroll, flow track, verb crossfade, fold with draft + typing unfolds, /bh-knowledge in chat, classifier kinds jev/laya/clef/rules in Settings, seat tooltips). npm test + bh check pass.

Step 15 comments: object { id c<number>, step|line, quote, text, at, open, edited? }. Commands: bh task comment <task> --edit <cid> --data <b64> | --delete <cid>; bh task resolve <task> --comment <cid>; the same three for bh plan. A comment on an agent reply lives on the chat feed entry (entry.comments) and is sent to that agent; a knowledge note's Resolve and Delete both take the note back.

Comment actions ready: bh task|plan comment <id> --edit <cid> --data <text> | --delete <cid>; bh task|plan resolve <id> --comment <cid>; all --json print the comment (removed one for delete). Edit sets text, edited, open:true. Ids are c<max+1>. Note: --data is URI-encoded (decodeURIComponent, as for adding), not base64.

design-comments: step 14 (bh-ask-dim, bc-ask-min, bar names who waits) and step 15 views (commentRow in work.js shared with chat; task/plan --edit/--delete/resolve --comment; knowledge unnote/note; reply comments on feed entries via feed.js helpers). npm test passes.

QA gate CHANGES_REQUIRED: ACP bh ask cancelled (runner.mjs:362), one-shot killed on ask start, classifier Off ignored for jev/laya/clef (classifier/index.mjs:124), undeclared .rotate in work.js:1138, composer doesn't fold on scroll. Report: .bot-herdr/tasks/t-20261110-p63g/reports/qa-gate.md

Fix round 1 done (by Orchestrator: both fix agents hit the Claude Code 5-hour limit): ACP now allows a bh ask permission and ends the turn on tool_call_update completed (runner.mjs); Claude/Codex/pi end the turn on the ask tool's result, not its start; classifier Off gates jev/laya/clef (classifier/index.mjs); knowledge notes drop the undeclared rotate; Tasks-page dots replaced by the chat's sliding track; composer folds on scroll-up and any feed click. npm test 97 pass / 0 fail, bh check PASS, tsc on views clean.

Also: runner stop() resolves taskkill from System32 (no PATH dependency, kill() fallback) — the bare spawn crashed headless agents where PATH is empty; BOM and mojibake removed from runner.mjs, headless.test.mjs and acp-reply.test.mjs. New tests: ask flow for Claude, Codex, pi and ACP; classifier Off wins over every kind.

QA gate findings fixed and verified (npm test 97/0, bh check PASS, tsc clean); person accepted and shipped: installed, committed 9c19ff5, pushed to origin/main. Gate round 2 was orchestrator-verified; re-run any time with bh spawn qa --review.
